Dear Sir / Madam,
Sub: Disclosure under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure
Requirements) Regulations, 2015
With reference to our letter dated July 31, 2026, and in terms of Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that the management
had participated in a conference call today, August 6, 2026 (Thursday) organized by Spark Institutional
Equities Private Limited (Avendus Spark, Analyst) and it may be noted that no Unpublished Price Sensitive
Information (UPSI) was shared / discussed with the Analysts/Investors during the meeting.
We further wish to inform you that the audio recording of the Analysts/Investors Meet held today, August
6, 2026 (Thursday) is made available on the Company's website:-
https://www.sundram.com/recentupdate. php
It may also be noted that no presentation was made to the Analysts/Investors during the meeting.
Please take the above information on record.
Thanking you,
Yours truly,
For Sundram Fasteners Limited
G Anand Babu
